Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Our data shows a different picture on some points:

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your updated demand forecast and factored the increased volume into our calculation. 

To pass on these volume benefits, we must maintain the 30-day payment terms, as extending them to 90 days would necessitate a price increase. Consequently, we can offer a revised price of €369.76 per unit under the condition of 30 days net. This alternative at standard terms includes a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Otherwise, our offer stands at a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised proposal and appreciate the further step you have taken. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can offer an adjusted price of €371.95 per unit, maintaining the 90-day payment terms you requested. Our full offer comprises a price of €371.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Please note that we are reaching the limit of our flexibility under these extended payment terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
